tools.name: matches_seniority
tools.summary: Is this person at one of the seniority levels you target? Reads the main title by rules against Firmable's levels: Owner / Founder, C-Suite / Partner, Board Member / Company Director, VP/Director / Head of, Manager, Other. Short forms such as Director also match; an unrecognised level answers no. For "would they make the buying call", use `is_decision_maker`.
